environment.frameControl: Native NES.frame called deterministically while requestAnimationFrame emulator advancement is held; real app buttons own saves and lifecycle.

diagnosis.blackBackdrop: The initial black title backdrop is part of the SMB3 opening animation. The title reveals a tan backdrop around native frame420.
diagnosis.actualDefect: The JSNES2.1.0 renderer picked the preceding tile when an 8x16 sprite selected pattern table $1000. Its even-masked top tile had a second subtraction, fragmenting characters.
diagnosis.fix: For odd tile IDs, select (spriteTile & 0xFE) + 256 for the top tile, followed by its next tile.

oracles.algorithm: FNV-1a over native canvas RGB bytes, 256x240, starting from a cold native reload with a fixed48000Hz sample rate
oracles.visualReview: Before and after native frame600 inspected on a412x915 phone viewport; corrected Mario, Luigi and enemies use complete connected sprite halves. Frame390 keeps the intentional black backdrop.

limitations: Desktop Chromium emulating phone viewport and touch, not physical Android hardware.
Acceptance covers title graphics and save restoration, not a full game playthrough.
